[[File:Onderon_Rebels_rescue.jpg|thumb|right|237px|[[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] with a longblaster.]]
The term '''"longblaster"''' denoted any model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] with a long [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] for superior accuracy. Well-known models included the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A-280]], [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19]], and [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A]] models.

Longblasters with automatic selective firing settings could only attain rates of fire of about three shots per second, due to the sensitive energy accelerators located in the barrel. Rifles and [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbines]] such as the infamous [[E-11]] and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] had shorter barrels designed for mobility and portability, with less sensitive accelerators.
